selection_notes: Trois IDs existants du roster ont été annoncés au coordinateur avant génération; aucune variante d’un propriétaire refusé n’a été relancée.
Hunter et Dog utilisent des références officielles complémentaires. Dog conserve la référence primaire Half-Life 2; l’illustration anniversaire ne sert qu’à mieux voir ses extrémités.
Civil Protection a été remplacé avant toute demande par le fourmilion ouvrier d’Episode Two, dont une capture officielle permet une vraie comparaison.
Les trois demandes initiales ont réussi. Aucune demande de nettoyage ni génération supplémentaire n’a été nécessaire.

deferred_targets.reason: Aucune vue officielle entière et de la bonne variante n’a été retenue. Les captures Nova Prospekt de 220 ne décrivent pas un agent CP et les captures Deathmatch de 320 consultées ont un contexte/apparence inadéquats pour verrouiller ce modèle. Aucun refus ajouté.

alpha_review_correction.initial_observation: L’aperçu brut du Worker semblait comporter un halo vert; des franges rouge/jaune étaient apparentes sur les deux autres sujets.
alpha_review_correction.verified_conclusion: Lecture du canal A et composites alpha réels sur gris/blanc: le halo vert ne se compose pas et aucun halo coloré majeur n’est confirmé sur ces trois sprites. Les défauts de marges, pose et fidélité restent séparément documentés.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE complete isolated high-detail 2D raster character sprite of ONE retail Hunter from Half-Life 2: Episode Two. Use the attached official Valve screenshots as strict appearance references. In image 1 the intended subject is the smaller, dark, THREE-legged Hunter standing near the center foreground, not the tall Strider on the left. Image 2 gives the Hunter's close-up front shell and sensor detail. Only the Hunter is requested; do not include the Strider, other Hunters or any scenery.
Preserve the Hunter's compact heavy upper body, hunched forward silhouette, dark grey-brown organic-metallic shell with restrained green iridescent highlights, pale central face plate and exactly TWO round cyan sensors stacked vertically. Match the joint shapes, three-legged anatomy, foot shapes and body-to-leg proportions from the complete Hunter in image 1. The two front legs and the third rear leg all remain separately readable and complete, with their source-model angular joints and narrow lower feet. No fourth leg, no arms or hands, no separate animal head, no new weapons and no human proportions.
One quiet ready stance close to the complete source pose, at a near-front mild three-quarter view. Preserve the body design and take only the additional visible material and head detail from image 2. All THREE feet rest near the same horizontal baseline without a drawn floor. The flechette system is inactive; no projectile or muzzle flash.
The result is a crisp detailed raster sprite for a 2D fighting game, with controlled shaded texture and readable contour. Match the retail game design rather than redesigning a generic robot. No vector shapes, flat icon style, concept-art sheet or cinematic scene.
True transparent alpha everywhere outside the single Hunter; fully opaque materials inside the silhouette. Keep all body parts complete and center the subject with a generous transparent border of approximately 10 percent on every edge. No crop, ground, forest, dust, cast shadow, baked checkerboard, color fringe, halo, caption, UI, border, alternate view or duplicate creature.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE full-body high-detail 2D raster sprite of Dog, the large friendly scavenged robot from the released Half-Life 2 game. The first attached image is the primary official Valve in-game appearance and idle-pose reference. Dog is the large robot on the left; only Dog is requested. The second attached image is official Valve promotional art and provides supplementary views of Dog's complete mechanical hands, fingers, feet and exposed joints. Do not copy its airborne action pose or its other creature.
Match Dog's distinctive bulky, forward-hunched upper shell, enormous long mechanical arms, relatively compact bent legs, exposed cables, pistons, circular joints and irregular salvaged plates. Preserve his actual asymmetry: the two arms and gripping mechanisms have different hardware and shapes; do not mirror one arm to make a symmetrical robot. Keep the worn pale metal and dirty grey/cream/yellow shell patches, orange-rust sections, dark cables and aged metal texture shown in the primary screenshot. Do not add an animal face, ears, tail, dog paws or humanoid armour.
One grounded calm idle pose close to image 1, hunched and heavy, with long arms hanging low and the small sensor head tucked under the overhanging upper shell at the reference angle. Do not enlarge or invent a new face. Keep the complete hands and fingers inside the image, using the supplementary reference to avoid the hand-tip crop in image 1. Keep both feet complete, readable and planted near one horizontal baseline. Preserve the large robot proportions; do not shrink into a normal human-sized silhouette.
Paint this as a detailed 2D raster fighting-game sprite with crisp controlled shading and fine weathered pixel texture. Retain the source design and recognizable mechanical construction. No vector drawing, simplified icon, modern redesign or photoreal cinematic scene.
Only one robot isolated on true transparent alpha, with opaque metal interiors. Give at least about 10 percent empty transparent padding around the whole robot, including all fingers and feet. No human companion, no second creature, no landscape, floor, shadow ellipse, checkerboard, edge halo, colored fringe, text, labels, sheet, alternate angle or duplicate figure.

notes: Dog entier, silhouette lourde et voûtée, longs bras asymétriques, deux mains différentes, deux pieds, pistons et câbles conservés. La vue primaire reste celle du modèle Half-Life 2; le wallpaper Valve complète les extrémités.
Le capteur reste partiellement caché sous la coque dans cet angle; aucune nouvelle vue de son visage n’est prétendue. Une pose trois-quarts unique ne définit pas les deux orientations de combat.

La patine jaune/crème/orange suit la capture éclairée chaudement; elle ne constitue pas une validation de la couleur des matériaux sous éclairage neutre. Les pièces fines et proportions restent à comparer au modèle.
Marges au seuil alpha>=16: gauche 83, haut 32, droite 93, bas 26 px. Les mains sont entières, mais les marges haute et basse sont trop courtes pour la cible 10 %.

Les fortes franges rouge/jaune de l’aperçu RGB brut ne se confirment pas sur les composites alpha gris et blanc. Les contours sont lisibles sans halo coloré majeur; source PNG conservée sans retouche.
Alpha dominant 252/255, résidu alpha 1 au bord gauche. Aucune certification 1:1, animation ou intégration moteur.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Produce ONE complete isolated high-detail 2D raster creature sprite of the retail Antlion Worker from Half-Life 2: Episode Two. The attached official Valve screenshot is the exact appearance reference. The intended subject is the large pale green worker antlion in the foreground; exclude the distant insects and the cave.
Preserve this worker caste's unmistakable huge rounded pale yellow-green head, darker small mouth region, two long slender forward mouth appendages, pale green articulated FOUR-leg anatomy and the source model's rounded/striped shell and abdomen behind the head. Match its broad low body and exceptionally large head-to-body ratio. Maintain the exact leg shapes and arrangement, including the long pointed front legs and the rear limbs seen behind them. Do not substitute the green-and-ochre standard Antlion, an Antlion Guard, a six-legged realistic insect or a new fantasy creature. Keep the small dark surface marks and gently translucent-looking green material as painted surface shading, not an actually transparent body.
One grounded quiet idle pose close to the screenshot's near-front three-quarter angle, with the large head lowered and mouth appendages pointing forward. All four limbs and their pointed tips remain complete inside the canvas, with no anatomical additions. No acid spit, no explosion, no particles or newly invented glow.
Detailed shaded 2D raster sprite for a fighting game, source-faithful proportions and muted green palette, fine texture and crisp readable contour. No vector icon, cartoon simplification, multiple poses or cinematic environment.
True transparent alpha outside the single creature, opaque subject pixels inside. Keep approximately 10 percent empty transparent border on all sides and show every extremity. No cave, ground, rock, other creature, cast shadow, black background, baked checkerboard, colored outline or halo, lettering, HUD, sheet or duplicate image.

notes: Un seul fourmilion ouvrier, large tête pâle vert-jaune, coque arrière striée, longues pattes et deux appendices buccaux cohérents avec la capture Episode Two. Les quatre membres ne sont pas tous séparément lisibles: les pattes arrière sont repliées et partiellement masquées par le corps.

Le halo vert vu dans l’aperçu brut se trouve dans les RGB de pixels alpha 0. Les composites sur gris 128 et blanc montrent un fond uniforme sans ce halo. Aucune correction de fond n’a été demandée, car l’alpha réel était déjà présent.

Pose unique, pas de silhouette latérale opposée, pas de projection d’acide, pas de clip complet ni d’intégration moteur.
